1903 is not a leap year (1900 is not a leap year under Gregorian rules).  
03-23-1903 minus 163 days:  
March has 31 days, so back to March 1 is 22 days (23-1=22).  
163 - 22 = 141 days left to go back from March 1.  
February 1903 has 28 days → 141 - 28 = 113 days left, now at Feb 1.  
January has 31 days → 113 - 31 = 82 days left, now at Jan 1, 1903.  
Remaining 82 days go into 1902: December 1902 has 31 days → 82 - 31 = 51 left, now at Dec 1.  
November has 30 days → 51 - 30 = 21 left, now at Nov 1.  
October has 31 days, but we only need 21 days back from Nov 1 → Oct 11 (31 - 21 = 10 → Oct 11).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1902-10-11
